title: Security Scanners- Metal Detectors for Rent
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description_text: The Government seeks a qualified Contractor to provide eight (8) Dual Lane Weapons Detection Systems for rental, delivery set-up, and pick-up. The Contractor shall also train NDW operators on proper usage and for walk-through concealed weapon detection systems to support the NAS Patuxent River Air Show. Please see the attached solicitation for complete details.
